notes.title: Development Update #1 - "Creek of Spectral Falls"
notes.content:
Hello Wanderers,

We’re excited to bring you our first big Development Update for Death Howl in which we would like to show you some nice sneak peaks and updates. The whole team (well, the three of us here in Denmark) are working hard on the game and things are going smoothly! The official release date announcement is getting closer, but before all that, check out the brand new Gameplay and Demo!:

[previewyoutube=e4HaHSpD_fc;full][/previewyoutube]
First off, a huge thank you for all the amazing feedback on the demo! Your support has been incredibly motivating and keeps us pushing forward.

We’re happy to announce [b]that we are bringing the demo back starting June 9th, during the upcoming Steam Next Fest - updated, extended, and refined![/b] It’s the perfect time to step back into Ro’s shoes and journey once more into the spirit realm.

[h3]Enter the “Creek of the Spectral Falls” – a strange new region featuring:[/h3]
🦌 [b]New crafting cards[/b] and synergies to experiment with
🦌 [b]A boss fight with one of the Great Spirits: Cantharsis[/b]
🦌 [b]Core gameplay improvements[/b], including an enhanced progression system

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45446539/a6176198a4d3b10f71b503833bc0a511811c3104.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45446539/761a88f5d5e57da39fd340eff5f4faf8c910f3e0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45446539/4daa3bd55aa77387ca214ef8f5cd50a4e343dd1e.png[/img]

[h3]A Glimpse Behind the Veil[/h3]
That’s not all! We’ve been feeling a little nostalgic lately and stumbled upon some early production phase gems we’d love to share with you. Below, you’ll find a selection of [b]early concept sketches of the in-game map and locations as well as key art, and brainstorm assets from the very beginning of Death Howl’s journey[/b]. These pieces were created when the idea for the game was just starting to take shape. We hope you’ll enjoy it!:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45446539/37dc5056a2d89db89e2eb65cfc9c2c2b0ace6c04.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45446539/ea1cd00ba25aab38be5d9b4a7f68c31b54b6e1f4.jpg[/img]

Thank you once again for your continued support, feedback, and kind words. We hope you will enjoy the new demo even more than the first one and if you do, please consider leaving a review in the comments once it will be available. Every bit of feedback helps us make Death Howl even better!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45446539/dc9a58323a3f6a6c0f84c1b5f16c98ff8a2e1484.jpg[/img]

[b]Death Howl demo will be back starting June 9th, during the upcoming Steam Next Fest, don’t forget to try it![/b]

See you soon in the spirit realm. 🦌

~ The Outer Zone Team

notes.title: Thank you for playing the Death Howl Demo!
notes.content:
A huge THANK YOU to everyone who has played the Death Howl Demo! Your support and feedback mean the world to us, and every comment, suggestion, and bug report helps us make the game even better.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45446539/dfbc64a9c463dc9a64600682b47f645d8f2d4b64.png[/img]
We’re also incredibly excited to share that Death Howl Demo has received [b]95% positive reviews[/b]! 🎉 You have praised the atmospheric storytelling, strategic deck-building mechanics, and immersive world design, and we couldn’t be happier that you’re enjoying the experience.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45446539/916c6bbab2eb2275548b3975b4c3c82bf5f3f6ef.png[/img]
We appreciate all the effort you put into sharing your thoughts—it’s helping us shape the future of the game! And if you haven’t already, we’d love for you to complete our short feedback survey: [url=https://forms.gle/VhjkLrhVhRU8S1tn6]https://forms.gle/VhjkLrhVhRU8S1tn6[/url]

Wishlist Death Howl to stay updated on our progress, upcoming features, and release plans!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825880/Death_Howl/

If you haven’t played the demo yet, it’s still available for a limited time! Don’t miss it.


Take care,
The Outer Zone team and 11 bit studios

notes.title: Death Howl Demo update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We've just released a small patch to address some of the most frequently reported issues to make sure you have the best possible experience with the demo!

Bug fixes:[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where completing the burning tree and bird quest still allowed players to pick up the bird in its old spot.
[*] Resolved an issue where an enemy's movement indicator would stick around if they were killed at the exact moment their movement was displayed.
[*] Fixed an issue in the moose tutorial where players could walk completely out of frame.
[/list]
New Content & Improvements:[list]
[*] Polished up Overwhelmed Mode to make it easier to notice and use, with clearer visuals and helpful hints.
[*] Adjusted some terminology for clarity and fixed missing translations where needed.
[*] Smoothed out interactions with healing and fast travel to make things feel more natural.
[*] Fireball got a bit of a buff because, well, it needed more oomph.
[/list]
[b]Make sure to share your feedback and review the demo. Your input will help us make the best game possible![/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3365740/Death_Howl_Demo/

Take care,
The Outer Zone team and 11 bit studios

notes.title: Death Howl - Announcement Trailer
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Check out the latest game from The Outer Zone and 11 bit studios. Journey the sorrowful spirit world in soulslike deck builder, Death Howl. Craft cards and claim powerful totems to defeat the woeful spirits lurking in the mystical lands. Unravel the tale of a grieving mother in her desperate attempt to defy death and bring back her son.

[b]Watch the announcement trailer:[/b]
[previewyoutube=14MSXWMFIYg;full][/previewyoutube]
In forgotten lands shrouded by myth, Ro—a hunter from a small tribe—is overcome by grief following the death of her beloved son. Guided by voices from another world, she transcends into the realm of spirits, in hopes of bringing him back.

Death Howl weaves an atmospheric tale of grief, healing, and resilience. As Ro, you’ll face relentless spirits in turn-based battles that challenge your tactical sense and adaptability. To succeed, you must craft and master decks of powerful cards and use shamanic totems while unearthing forgotten tales and secrets that shape Ro’s path.

[b]🦌💔 Add Death Howl to your wishlist and play the demo on January 20th![/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825880/Death_Howl/

Take care,
The Outer Zone team and 11 bit studios
